_comment: FLUX.2 [Klein] 9B - Text to Image. Export (API) format, ready for a
bitGen Studio image style (Settings -> Image, Rendered by ComfyUI).
Derived from ComfyUI's own template, the DISTILLED klein 9B variant:
https://comfy.org/workflows/image_flux2_text_to_image_9b-1606e79dd224/
Node types, widget names and default values were taken from that file, not
from memory. The published template wraps all of this in a subgraph, which
is a UI-only construct; this is the same graph flattened, which is what
Export (API) produces and what /prompt accepts.
MODELS (into ComfyUI's OWN folders, not bitGen Studio's):
models/diffusion_models/flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors
models/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors
models/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors
Distilled: cfg 1.0, ~4 steps. For the BASE 9B checkpoint use
flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors with cfg 5.0 and ~20 steps, and
delete node 76 so the negative prompt is a real one instead of a zeroed
copy of the positive.
THE NEGATIVE PROMPT IS NOT A PROMPT HERE. Node 76 (ConditioningZeroOut)
takes the POSITIVE conditioning and zeroes it - that is what a distilled
model uses in place of a negative. Both of node 63's conditioning inputs
therefore trace back to node 74. bitGen Studio detects this and refuses to
write a negative prompt into it; writing one would overwrite the actual
prompt and render 'blurry, low quality' as the subject.
FOUR LORA SLOTS (101-104) ship BYPASSED. Their lora_name is empty, and an
empty lora_name is not a no-op in ComfyUI - it fails validation. bitGen Studio
fills slots from the style's LoRA stack in order and removes the unused
ones, passing model and clip straight through, before the graph is queued.
So this file is a template, not a runnable graph: do not drag it into
ComfyUI and press Run with the slots empty.
